findings.vulnerability: Delayed State Finality Proof Verification Allows Double-Spend Arbitrage Across L2s
findings.impact: Arbitrageurs can withdraw liquidity on destination L2 before source L1 burn transaction is finalized.

findings.vulnerability: Integer Overflow in Dynamic Gas Fee Scaling on Cross-Chain Relay
findings.impact: Relayer fees truncate to zero under extreme congestion, draining bridge native gas reserves.
